upload.heading: Bulk Upload via Excel
upload.description: Upload a .xlsx file with fleet vehicle data. Records are upserted on Asset No (existing records updated, new ones created). Download the template first to ensure correct column headers.
upload.intakeCenterSuffix: for validated, audited, multi-country imports with duplicate detection and rollback.
upload.errEmpty: File is empty or has no data rows

delete.title: Delete Vehicle
delete.question: Delete vehicle {assetNo}?
delete.warning: This removes the fleet record permanently. Tyre history records for this asset are not affected.
delete.errNoPermission: The vehicle could not be deleted - you may not have permission, or it was already removed.
delete.hasHistory: {assetNo} has history: {history}. Deleting it would leave those records pointing to a vehicle that no longer exists. Mark it Inactive instead: it leaves the active fleet and its history is kept.
delete.unknownHistory: The vehicle's history could not be checked, so it cannot be deleted permanently right now. Mark it Inactive instead, or try again later.
delete.noHistory: No inspections, tyre records, work orders or accidents are linked to this vehicle.
delete.markedInactive: {assetNo} marked Inactive. Its history is kept.
delete.errMarkInactive: Could not mark the vehicle Inactive.

bulkDelete.title: Delete Vehicles
bulkDelete.question: Delete {count} selected vehicle(s)?
bulkDelete.warning: This removes the fleet records permanently. Tyre history records for these assets are not affected.
bulkDelete.errNoPermission: No rows were deleted — you may not have permission (Admin only) or they were already removed.
bulkDelete.errFailed: Bulk delete failed. Please try again.
bulkDelete.checking: Checking the history of {count} selected vehicle(s)...
bulkDelete.groupClean: {count} have no linked records and can be deleted permanently.
bulkDelete.groupHistory: {count} have inspections, tyre records, work orders or accidents. They cannot be deleted; mark them Inactive to keep their history.
bulkDelete.groupUnknown: {count} could not be checked, so they cannot be deleted permanently right now. Mark them Inactive or try again later.
bulkDelete.markedInactive: {count} vehicle(s) marked Inactive. Their history is kept.
bulkDelete.errMarkInactive: Could not mark the vehicles Inactive.
